traits.name: Divine Smite (2/Day)
traits.description: Immediately after the paladin hits a creature with a melee weapon, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Sacred Longsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Compelled Duel (1/Day)
actions.description: The paladin challenges one creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or, for 1 minute (Concentration), have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the paladin, and must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw to willingly move more than 30 feet away from it. The effect ends early if the paladin attacks or casts a spell at another creature.

reactions.name: Stone's Endurance (2/Day)
reactions.description: When the paladin takes damage, it reduces the damage by 7 (1d12 + 1).

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: The cleric has Advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the cleric can see within 60 feet. Failure: 4 (1d8) Radiant damage. Success: No damage.
actions.target: one creature the cleric can see within 60 feet

actions.name: Life Domain Magic
actions.description: The cleric uses one of the following, each once per day. Cure Wounds: it touches a creature, which regains 13 (2d8 + 4) Hit Points. Bless: up to three creatures it can see within 30 feet add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute (Concentration). Preserve Life: it presents its holy symbol and restores 15 Hit Points, divided as it chooses among any number of Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of it (which can include itself); a creature can't be restored to more than half its Hit Point maximum this way.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: One creature the cleric can see within 60 feet regains 9 (2d4 + 4) Hit Points.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The druid has Advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

actions.name: Ray of Frost
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Cold damage. The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the druid's next turn.
actions.additional_ruling: The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the druid's next turn.

actions.name: Circle of the Land Magic
actions.description: The druid uses one of the following. Hold Person (1/Day): one Humanoid it can see within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute (Concentration), repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the effect on itself on a success. Entangle (1/Day): each creature in a 20-foot square of ground within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute (Concentration); a Restrained creature can take an action to make a DC 11 Strength (Athletics) check, ending the condition on itself on a success, and the area is Difficult Terrain for the duration. Land's Aid (2/Day): each creature of its choice in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 60 feet makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success, and one creature of its choice in the area regains 7 (2d6) Hit Points.

traits.name: Assassinate and Sneak Attack
traits.description: The assassin has Advantage on Initiative rolls, and during the first round of combat it has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. Once per turn, it deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits with a weapon attack that has Advantage, or when the target is within 5 feet of one of its allies that doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance (1/Day)
traits.description: When the assassin is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.description: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
